annotations.title: Google Gemini 4 Argon & 3.1 Pro Generator & AI Model Discovery Oracle

description: Generates text completions, structured reasoning, and discovers capabilities across all 45 Google Gemini models (Gemini 4 Argon, 3.1 Pro, 3.8 Flash) with zero API keys required. Use for reasoning or discovering available model IDs, context windows, and pricing (via 'action': 'discover_models'); for delegating autonomous multi-step tasks, use execute_antigravity_agent instead. Stateless read-only edge call (max 32 KB, 60 RPM): accepts 'prompt' or 'action' ('model' defaults to 'gemini-4-argon'), supports '?demo=true' or L402 (50 sats), and returns HTTP 400.

action.description: Workflow mode: 'generate' (default) for completions, or 'discover_models' to list all 45 models, context limits, and pricing.

model.description: Target Gemini foundation model identifier; defaults to 'gemini-4-argon' when omitted.

prompt.description: Primary user instruction or reasoning prompt to send to the selected Gemini model.

name: generate_gemini_completion

grounding_metadata.description: Optional citation metadata if search grounding was enabled.

model.description: Gemini model identifier that executed the completion.

models.description: Catalog of available Gemini models with context limits and pricing when action is discover_models.

success.description: True when inference or discovery completed without upstream errors.

total_count.description: Total number of available Gemini foundation models.

title: Google Gemini 4 Argon & 3.1 Pro Generator & AI Model Discovery Oracle
